title: Requirements: timeline-diagram
response:
Feedback Summary (7 comments):

Specific Text Comments:
1. "[`azure-pipeline-diagram`](../azure-pipeline-diagr...": Wherever possible code will be made 'generic' and reused by putting it in the corresponding projects.
2. "`MoveElementRequest.position` and `IDiagramSession...": Wherever possible code will be made 'generic' and reused by putting it in the corresponding projects.
3. "".yml"": The extension needs to be .tml, which stands for "Timeline Markup Language"
4. "interval": Not an interval, but rather a period - a moment in time with a begin and end.
5. "IF end is earlier than begin ": The diagram and property grid SHALL never allow this to be inputed. so the only way this can happen is by manual text editing.
6. "WHEN the vertical position is stored THEN it SHALL...": It should in fact be a row. so each element can be positioned on a row, time wise there can of course be more elements on the same row, but when the user drags elements they will snap to the closest vertical row. When dragging the connections (bezier curves) will also be visualized).
7. "x is time": x can also be authored, when the user for example changes the begin/end properties in the grid and/or drags an element horizontally in a row.
